title: Reason codes
wordsOnly: Scrap and rework reasons keep their words in Italian and English only: icons, colours, other floor languages and "asks for a note" come later for these two lists.

listHint.PAUSE: Why work paused at a station: the floor's pause tiles.
listHint.DOWNTIME: Why a machine or a line stopped.
listHint.HELP_CALL: What a help call from the floor is about.
listHint.ADJUSTMENT: Why a count or a stock figure differs: every counted line that differs names one.
listHint.HOLD: Why goods were put on hold.
listHint.CANCEL: Why an order, a line or a document was cancelled.
listHint.WRITE_OFF: Why stock was written off (damaged, expired, obsolete, lost).
listHint.RETURN: Why a customer sent goods back: each return line names one.
listHint.DISCREPANCY: What was wrong with a delivery: short, over, wrong or damaged.
listHint.CLAIM: Why we claim against a supplier.
listHint.DOWNGRADE: Why goods went down to a lower quality.
listHint.SCRAP: Why a garment is lost at an operation: the operation screen's scrap tiles.
listHint.REWORK: Why a garment goes back to be made again: the operation screen's rework tiles.
